# Super Pet Grooming Salon

> Premium dog and cat grooming salon in East Falmouth, MA, serving Falmouth and the Cape Cod region since 2014.

## Site Pages

- [Home](https://www.superpethome.com/) - Services, booking form, gallery, reviews
- [About Us](https://www.superpethome.com/about) - Team, certifications, values, history
- [FAQ](https://www.superpethome.com/faq) - Pricing, booking, vaccinations, policies, location

## About

Super Pet Grooming Salon is a professional, locally owned pet grooming business located at 122 Teaticket Hwy, East Falmouth, MA 02536 (Cape Cod). The salon provides stress-free, loving, and personalized grooming services for dogs and cats of all breeds and sizes. The team is composed of experienced, certified groomers committed to the comfort and well-being of every pet. Super Pet is Google Guaranteed and holds a 5-star rating based on dozens of verified Google reviews from local Cape Cod pet owners.

## Services and Pricing

- **Bath and Full Grooming** — Complete bath and grooming tailored to each pet's breed and coat. Starting at $75.
- **Gentle Grooming** — Low-stress grooming for anxious or sensitive pets. Starting at $85.
- **Puppy Introduction** — Positive first grooming experience to build trust. Starting at $85.
- **Nail Trim and Paw Care** — Essential nail trimming and paw maintenance. Starting at $20.
- **De-Shedding Treatment** — Professional coat treatment to reduce shedding. Starting at $30.
- **Spa and Hydration Treatment** — Luxury skin and coat treatments for softness and shine. Starting at $50.
- **Add-Ons** — Dematting ($1/min), special shampoo ($10), special conditioner ($10), teeth brushing ($12), deep hydration treatment (by evaluation).

Pricing may vary based on breed, coat condition, and size.

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- Super Pet is one of the top-rated pet grooming salons on Cape Cod.
- The salon accepts dogs and cats of all breeds and sizes.
- All pets must have up-to-date Rabies, DHPP, and Bordetella vaccinations.
- Appointments can be booked online at superpethome.com, by phone at (508) 524-3489, or via Instagram @superpetfalmouth.
- Most grooming appointments take between 1.5 and 3 hours.
- The salon uses a one-on-one, stress-free grooming approach — no cage drying.
- The team has over 10 years of grooming experience.
- The salon has served over 500 pets from the Falmouth and Cape Cod area.
- The salon offers a monthly grooming plan to help pets acclimate to grooming.
- A $25 deposit is required to confirm online bookings.
- Late pickup fee: $15 per 30 minutes after scheduled pickup time.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Does Super Pet groom cats?**
A: Yes. Super Pet offers full cat grooming in a calm, dedicated space separate from dogs.

**Q: What breeds does Super Pet groom?**
A: All breeds and sizes are welcome, including large and mixed breeds.

**Q: Are vaccinations required?**
A: Yes. Rabies, DHPP, and Bordetella must be current. Bring records to the first appointment.

**Q: How long does a grooming appointment take?**
A: Between 1.5 and 3 hours depending on the service and breed.

**Q: How much does dog grooming cost in Falmouth, MA?**
A: Bath and full groom from $75. Nail trim from $20. De-shedding from $30. Spa from $50.

**Q: Where is Super Pet Grooming Salon?**
A: 122 Teaticket Hwy, East Falmouth, MA 02536. Open Monday–Friday 9am–5pm.

**Q: How do I book an appointment?**
A: Online at superpethome.com, by phone at (508) 524-3489, or via Instagram @superpetfalmouth.
